scope: Temporal self-refinement of paired early/late voltage responses on the unchanged 64-us two-task panel; numerical execution and signal-stability outcomes are reported separately.
purpose: Check whether nanovolt timing contrasts survive smaller timesteps before changing readers or making a new decoding claim.
panel: All 80 original worlds at all three resolutions; original physical event times, doses, model, initial state and readout support unchanged. No retraining or new classifier.
historical_comparison: Compare the original 1-us histories using the existing field-specific physical tolerances in test_betse_junction_runtime.compare and the unchanged voltage readout tolerances. Record exact agreement and all differing fields separately. Within-run reorder, partition, window and snapshot replay remain bitwise. This corrects the overly strict historical equality check from the failed first run without changing physics or signal-stability criteria.

contrast.definition: late minus early area-weighted voltage, paired at fixed arm, location and cue strength; 21 features at the original completed times
contrast.criteria_rationale: The absolute stability limit uses the original synthetic reader margin; the signal floor is twice that margin. The 10% limit requires small relative change as well. These are declared numerical diagnostics, not measured sensor precision or a continuum error bound.
contrast.stable_at_finest_steps: The 0.5-to-0.25-us contrast change must satisfy BOTH absolute and relative limits. Report separately whether the finest signal exceeds the declared floor, and whether the original 1-us contrast meets the same limits against 0.25 us.
contrast.order_resolution: For each coordinate, a difference of two paired contrasts uses four inherited voltage comparison allowances: 4*atol + 2*rtol*(max_abs_early + max_abs_late). The two successive L2 changes must each exceed five times its L2 norm before interpreting their ratio as resolved first-order refinement. This comparison allowance is not a statistical noise estimate.

scope_exclusions: This is a follow-up on already-inspected inputs, not fresh held-out scientific validation. The original two-task failure is unchanged.
A passing suite does not imply a resolved or stable timing signal. Report every pair and all declared resolution outcomes, including negative results.
No decoder changes, feature selection, post-hoc threshold tuning, stronger cues, longer physical horizon, or biological sensor-noise calibration.
Same native per-moving-ion junction clock, with binary junction availability only. No partial stored-opening blocks or redefinition of physical clock semantics.
CPU/L4 temporal self-refinement only: no new native mixed-intervention, continuum/spatial convergence, biological, memory, causal-consumer or polycomputing claim.
Single-task unused labels and no-cue duplicates are numerical controls, not independent preparations; all world executions are retained with explicit identities.
Record GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage; equal panel solver work across arms is not a throughput or multi-GPU qualification.
